verdict.rationale: The GitHub README confirms vLLM can be built from source for development, so the core build path exists. Nothing in the evidence addresses how few external dependencies that build needs, and the install path ties into PyTorch backends ("--torch-backend auto"), so the minimal-dependency half is unsupported. Missing for 10: documentation of source build steps and requirements, evidence of a minimal or optional dependency footprint, independent hands-on reports of building from source.
